urlPath.description: Path only. Never include the query string.

timeline.description: Time series from summary().timeline. Bucket and long task field names are listed inside. loafs are Long Animation Frames (fields in loafFields, loafScriptFields); componentTiming says whether component update timing ran. Stage hitches carry work: per-frame update/render split, top components, texture, shader and instantiate time, lbl: label layout time with the top label groups by folded node path, font and settings (never the text), texCanvas: canvas texture uploads (system-font and TTF labels) with the top label groups, sp: Spine skeleton data parsed on first use, act: node activations (on, off, same-frame switch-backs, slowest node path), hd: editor-wired callbacks (component.handler of the slowest), ws: WebSocket message handlers (count, time, size of the slowest; never the payload).

area.description: CPU, 記憶體, draw call, 穩定性, or 卡頓. Defaults to the stage name.

rule.description: A Cocos rule id from protocol/rules.md. Replaces that rule's generic row.

entry.description: How the run got from loading to the first spin. See 進遊戲 in protocol/scenarios.md.

fps.description: Written by report/analyze.js. One row per stage group: fps, fpsLow (1% low), badShare, level.

losses.description: Written by report/analyze.js. Points each scored item cost (weights normalized as in the score; a score's points add up to 100 minus its uncapped score): all, top (largest three across the three scores, with stage, why: up to two plain sentences on where and why from the evidence, shown in the report; tool stays for leads and is not shown), caps (fatal caps with the uncapped score).

todo.description: Written by report/analyze.js. issues plus cocosAdvice items, worst first.

stages.description: Probe stages. uploads: texture uploads by source (canvas = system-font and TTF labels, image, data) and labels: label uploads by folded node path, with same (re-uploads with unchanged text) and when they happened (enable, render, component).

resources.description: Compact resource timing. Paths have no query string. `load` counts requests that started before game-ready, by kind. files: those requests as [start ms, end ms, KB or -1 when the server gives no size, short path, asset name]; sizes says whether sizes were available; bloated: picture files over 4 bytes a pixel. Missing on older runs.

progress.description: Loading screen percentage while loading, as [ms from probe start, percent] when it changed.

loadStops.description: Written by report/analyze.js. Where the loading percentage stood still loadProgress.stopMs or more, with the files downloading meanwhile.

paint.description: Browser paint timing in ms from navigation start: fp, fcp, and t0 (probe start on the same clock). Missing on older runs.

shaders.description: compileShader and linkProgram time. status none means no call was observed.

audio.description: decodeAudioData PCM bytes. status none means no decode was observed.

gc.description: Heap floor right after a forced full GC (heap snapshot): after-warmup, mid (halfway through the spins after warm-up), end, and after-feature when a free game was bought

stalls.description: Written by report/analyze.js. Every stall in time order: t, stage, dt, cause (a few words), kind (the cause kind), who (its component, script, label path or node name), canvasShare, counted (how many times the 卡頓頻率 item counted it).

leads.description: Written by report/analyze.js, for slot-perf-drill; the report shows only why. One per deduction in losses.all, largest first: category, id, label, points, value, unit, stage, reach (loading, idle, history, rules, menu, spin, turbo, feature: the state to get the page into), why (the plain sentences the report shows), suspects (kind stall with what and n, label with path and same-text count, subtree with path and screens or node counts, file, image, texture, made), numbers, tool (when the run already knows which slot-perf-drill tool answers it).

points.description: From the autopilot: map (spin, menu, history, rules, turbo, buy points and the InMenu flags), close points, frame (the game frame's offset on the page; add it for page points when the game is in an iframe), and viewport { w, h, dpr }, in CSS pixels of the game frame. No URL.

longSpins.description: Written by report/analyze.js. Spins over longSpinFactor times their series median: seconds, FPS, 1% low, max draw calls, stalls.

spinNodes.description: From the autopilot: [spin stage name, active nodes] taken in the gap after each spin settled (worse-from-spin rule).

census.description: Probe census after idle, after the panels (after-rules) and after each forced GC (after-warmup, mid, end): nodes, paths as [folded path, nodes, active] (at most 1000), made: instantiated nodes still referenced, by source name, split into inScene, detached and destroyed, and invisible: render nodes still drawn though nothing shows (own box outside the camera view, scale-0 boxes; in 2.x realtime Spine alpha-0 attachments with their area in screens, and skeletons with nothing to draw, nodes inside the view but clipped away by an ancestor mask), each grouped by folded path, and coverage: the area drawn nodes fill in screens, by the first three path levels (fill-layers rule). made also counts nodes held by cc.NodePool (pooled). Counts only.

nodeGrowth.description: Written by report/analyze.js: scene groups and instantiated nodes that grew from after-warmup to end.

panelNodes.description: Written by report/analyze.js: scene groups that grew from idle to after-rules.

feature.description: The bought free game or feature: ms from confirm until the base game was back, and back (whether it came back). coverage.feature says why it is missing.
